title: 4-player clarity: make it obvious that up to 4 people can play
problem: The owner couldn't find how to play with 4 people. Online, the lobby says 'Invite a friend', shows one empty row ('Waiting for a friend to join') and a small grey '1/4'. On the same phone, 4 people means picking 3 rival shops and switching each to Friend, which nothing explains. 4-person online rooms work (checked 2026-10-26: four joined and played, a fifth was refused 'This room is full').
scope: Online lobby: heading 'Invite friends (up to 3)'; a clear 'Players 1 of 4' count; one row per open seat ('Open seat: send the link'); when full, 'Room full: start when everyone is ready'
Home screen: a small line under 'Play a friend': '2 to 4 players online'
Quick match screen: one line 'Quick match is always 2 players. For 3 or 4, use Play a friend.'
New game screen: a line under 'Rival shops': 'Up to 4 shops. Pick Friend to pass this phone around.' and a total like '4 shops: you, 2 friends, 1 computer'
Automated 4-person online test added to the browser suite
exclusions: Rules, balance, the 4-player limit, quick match size
Button labels used to navigate (kept so links and tests keep working)

acceptance.text: Lobby shows 'Players N of 4' and one open-seat row per free seat; numbers update as people join and when computer shops are added
With 4 people, no open seats remain and the lobby says the room is full
A new browser test: 4 people join one room, all see the game, a 5th is refused
Home, quick match and new game screens show the new lines on a 360 px wide phone without overflow (screenshots)
Store screenshots change only where intended (home and lobby text)
verify:full green in CI; no rules, server or save changes
